_what: Planning policy for tool:plan-my-time. window_days: how far ahead it plans. stale_days: a task whose deadline passed longer ago is not planned (Motion uses 14). chunks: a task shorter than below_minutes may be split into pieces of at least min_block_minutes (null keeps it whole), as Motion does. pursuit_weight: the value of serving a needle-mover pursuit, any other pursuit, or none. priority_weight multiplies that value. schedule: working hours per weekday in the person's time zone when the request gives none. Any of these can be overridden per request under rules. gap_minutes: free time kept between placed work and anything else. slot_choice: tasks longer than for_tasks_over_minutes skip gaps shorter than skip_gaps_below_minutes, and tasks up to fewest_pieces_up_to_minutes go into one gap when one fits. daily_cap_minutes: most work planned per weekday (or per date), null for no cap; a day over its cap comes back with a bump list. rollover_alert_at: a task that has moved this many days comes back as needs_decision. schedules: named working hours a task can choose with schedule (theme days, a pursuit's hours).
